nodes.label: Six Detector Fixes (12/14 Hit Rate)
nodes.rationale: Wick gates converted to confidence modifiers, relaxed spring/UT/UTAD gates, SOS/SOW no-context fallback: hit rate 3/14 to 12/14; ETH cross-validation 5/6 without retuning; alpha comes from SOS/Spring/LPS, SC/BC are state-machine scaffolding only.

nodes.label: spring_b Look-Ahead Fix
nodes.rationale: detect_spring_type_b read future closes (close.shift(-offset)) so batch runs repainted while live could not reproduce; fixed to causal candidate/confirm pattern; guarded by tests/test_wyckoff_causality.py.

nodes.label: SM No-Context Fallback
nodes.rationale: State machine discarded springs/UTs without a validated SC-AR structure and SC's triple-extreme gate almost never validates one (9 springs / 8.5y); fallback fires at 0.5x confidence — externally validated by Wyckoff Insider's practice (springs valid inside reaccumulation without a fresh climax); shipped ON after holdout +$9.3K co-move pass.

nodes.label: Wyckoff Insider (WI)
nodes.rationale: User-sourced trader whose public corpus (6 batches, fully extracted) supplied the M2 schematic, RTZ entry, LPS-anchored stops, Bojan/UNF vocabulary, HTF-permission-as-dial architecture, and the fixed-structural-range doctrine; his architecture is size-tiers not vetoes, matching the project's boosts-over-filters evidence exactly.

nodes.label: Accumulation Schematic #2 (M2)
nodes.rationale: Bogomazov/Pruden schematic: phase-C LPS above support with NO spring — the LPS comes BEFORE the SOS, which was literally unrepresentable in the original state machine; M2 sequencer path built but sm_m2_path default OFF (train-up/OOS-down); survives as the shadow phase driving wyckoff_phase_dir for the validated boost.

nodes.label: wyckoff_phase_boost (Boost 6)
nodes.rationale: 1.25x sizing for any long archetype when phase_dir==C_accum: co-move both eras (train +$8.6K, hold +$769), boosts 6-for-6 — C_accum context makes EXISTING archetype entries better even though raw spring entries inside C_accum have no standalone edge (the split verdict).

nodes.label: wyckoff_campaign Standalone Rejected
nodes.rationale: Full-story mechanization 0/3; v1 died on inverted exit geometry (wide structural stop, R-ladder-capped winners); v2 gate with decoded WI geometry also failed 2/3 windows — the raw C_accum+spring entry has no standalone edge under either geometry; it was never the exits.

nodes.label: Bojan Zones / UNF Levels
nodes.rationale: Wick-tip-centered multi-timeframe zones (influence @Bojan_618); invalidated by close-beyond, converting to unfinished (UNF) magnets; the legacy 70% wick threshold is OUR invention not his; struct-anchored detector fixed location (97.4% at range low) but edge rejected 2/3 — faithful test (Bojan intersect armed accumulation) awaits live data.

nodes.label: Capex Boost Crowd-Out Saturation
nodes.rationale: Real per-trade discriminators (rotation-calm, depth>=2, above-POC) kept being found but the capex-boost action channel is saturated — the margin-constrained book cannibalizes itself at concurrency pileups; crowd-out originates in scoped cap-exemption consuming shared margin, not cohort size; boosts must be surgical AND a >50%-of-book condition is a leverage change in boost clothing.

nodes.label: Non-Binding Wallet Method Rule
nodes.rationale: User correction validated: margin crowd-out is a paper-wallet artifact contaminating edge measurement — at $2M zero rejections and residual ~$0; permanent rule: edge discovery runs on a NON-BINDING wallet, finite-capital expression is a separate engineering question. Boosts 7 (rotation_calm) and 8 (poc_validity) re-validated as signals; prior rejects retracted as capital-competition artifacts.

nodes.label: Rolling-Window vs Structural-Range Disease
nodes.rationale: Systemic sensor bug: springs, POC, Bojan, and premium/discount all keyed off rolling extremes instead of a drawn structural range — springs fired at arbitrary fresh-20-bar-lows mid-trend (only ~25-40% at a real swing low), rolling POC was a trend proxy (phi 0.5 with ema200), Bojan stub fired dead-center of range. One keystone fix (swing-pivot-anchored range redrawn on body-close MSS) repairs all at once.

nodes.label: Structural Range (1D N=5 Anchor)
nodes.rationale: idea_lab causal persistence state machine drawing boxes from swing pivots, held until body-close break; 1H anchors gave only 0.4-day ranges — weeks-long human boxes required 1D N=5 fractal pivots (13.7d median dwell, max 71.5d); fixed spring mislocation and POC trend-contamination partially; SENSOR validated, NOT edge.

nodes.label: Meta-Labeling / Conjunctive Architecture
nodes.rationale: Fusion (weighted average) is the wrong SHAPE: trading confluence is non-compensatory (conjunctive, weakest-link); correct architecture = regime gate -> conjunctive sequence -> meta-label sizing (Lopez de Prado). Prototype GBT rejected (purged-CV AUC 0.52) but confirmed the thesis in its own anatomy: structure+regime+context importance 0.93 vs archetype identity 0.03; the crude deployed boost stack beats the trained model OOS — the hand-built boosts are v1 of the correct architecture.

nodes.label: Temporal Gates Net-Positive (Crowd-Out Governor)
nodes.rationale: The founding TIME doctrine (fib bar-count clusters, multiplicative price-x-time confluence) is real and partly live; ablation showed the deployed time gates beat OFF in all three windows (+$21.4K/+$17.3K/+$8.8K) — but the book value is largely as a CROWD-OUT GOVERNOR keeping an over-firing archetype in check, not per-entry winner discrimination (price-x-time boost itself rejected 1/3).

nodes.label: All-Seeing Eye Closed
nodes.rationale: Closed in every testable form: standalone strategy fails 2/3 eras even in the clean idea-lab and on fixed sensors (0-for-5 standalone unified), sizing dial failed the untouched fold (era-stability is rarer than mechanism-plausibility), detection kept as infrastructure; trader knowledge mechanizes as CONTEXT/SIZING, never as standalone whole-strategies; surviving yield = the C_accum boost.

nodes.label: Regime Stand-Down (The Unaddressed Lever)
nodes.rationale: The recurring killer across the entire campaign: a long-biased book bleeds in markdowns because NOTHING makes it stand down when the regime turns — the genuine unaddressed lever is a regime stand-down DIAL (not a veto; filters are 0/9), requiring the CMI regime block materialized into store+live plus fresh live data.

nodes.label: BOMS Direction Fix + HTF-State Pulse
nodes.rationale: tf4h/tf1d_boms_direction were dead because direction was discarded on displacement-only breaks; fix emits the known break side. First fair HTF-state probe: 1H bull-BOS trigger + HTF BOMS-bull state = 77% win vs 54% for a plain trend filter — a promising pulse for the founding HTF-state-gates-LTF-entry vision, but n=35 clustered, unproven.

nodes.label: Idea-Lab Clean Screener
nodes.rationale: Clean single-strategy backtester (0.00% parity vs independent referee, cost bug fixed, no fusion/dedup/crowd-out/chunk artifacts possible) — the fast idea-screener for extracted knowledge before engine integration; the engine stays source of truth for live-parity.

nodes.label: Exodus Refusal
nodes.rationale: wick_trap entry refusal when stables rotation is rising (money fleeing to stables) — the only entry-refusal ever to pass; the narrow deployed slice of the stables_rot_rising signal; positive 3 consecutive eras since stables became structurally meaningful (2023+).

nodes.label: stables_rot_rising Rotation Signal
nodes.rationale: 3/3-fold-consistent book-wide discriminator (long PF ~1.5 when rotation calm vs ~0.7 rising); as a capex boost it failed twice from crowd-out but was re-validated as a pure signal on the non-binding wallet; survives deployed only in narrow forms (exodus refusal, depth>=2 tier).

nodes.label: Moneytaur (Thin Corpus)
nodes.rationale: Provenance ledger: Moneytaur corpus is thin — one rejected trailing formula plus a co-branded context-first school; the rich dominance/breadth/SMT doctrine is actually WI-sourced or joint; do not attribute it to Moneytaur.

nodes.label: BC Inversion + v2 Shadow Detectors
nodes.rationale: BC fires on rallies live (fwd +1.20%/72h) because _range_position is close-based so rejection tops fail at_highs; detect_climax_v2 shadow columns gate on the extreme reached plus rejection/reversal; spring_b_anchored (add.31 implemented) keeps the good springs; promotion requires its own boost-shaped validation.
